task.description: Produce the fix design artefact for ISSUE-FIXER Step 1 diagnosis. Diagnosis summary: C22021 'invalid byte 0xaa' originates server-side in migrations/035_adp09_tamper_evident_audit_chain.sql (bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash declares p_resource_id UUID but audit_entries.resource_id is TEXT since GBL-081). Produce a design document at src/design/audit_chain_text_resource_id.md. Required sections per templates/lego-catalog.md § E (Type E - Novel / cross-cutting): (1) Module summary, (2) Affected files with exact line ranges and one-line change description per file, (3) Schema/migration changes — list the new migration filename (must follow NNN_<topic>.sql ordering) and the exact DDL operations to perform (CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ... with new TEXT signature; trigger recompilation; GBL-081 chained correction if needed), (4) Public function signatures (Zig-side: helpers.zig TestHarness deinit, audit.zig writeAuditInTx; SQL-side: bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash, bpm_audit_chain_canonical_payload, bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash signatures + bodies in pseudo-SQL), (5) Error taxonomy (any PL/pgSQL EXCEPTION blocks that must be added to keep audit writes from blocking business writes), (6) Test contract — list exact TCs that must pass: TC-EE-10-06, TC-EXT-01-INT-07, TC-SCH-02-02, plus a new TC-AUDIT-UTF8 covering non-UTF-8 resource_id INSERT, (7) Migration safety — explicit reasoning about why this is not a destructive schema change; the chain hash function is REPLACED so its old signature must still be callable for callers that already pass UUID (use TEXT and let PostgreSQL implicit-cast accept UUID, or DROP SIGNATURE before CREATE OR REPLACE). Catalog this as Type E per templates/lego-catalog.md — cross-cutting (audit subsystem + 4 migrations + 1 test file). NO implementation code inside the design. NO SQL DDL outside the migration text — only DDL OUTLINES.
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement in ISSUE-FIXER diagnosis acceptance criteria maps to a design element

result.summary: Produced Type E design artefact at src/design/audit_chain_text_resource_id.md covering the audit chain hash TEXT resource_id + non-UTF-8 resilience fix (ISS-0122 / GH #388). Lint-clean (tools/lint_design_artefact.py exits 0; no BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR). The design maps every acceptance criterion from the ISSUE-FIXER diagnosis to a design element: 7-section structure (module purpose, affected files, schema/migration changes, public interface, error taxonomy, test contract, migration safety) per templates/lego-catalog.md Type E; new corrective migration numbered 1107 (one greater than the current max 1106, determined by scratch/_list_last_migration_number.py); 3 pre-fix failing TCs (TC-EE-10-06, TC-EXT-01-INT-07, TC-SCH-02-02) plus the new TC-AUDIT-UTF8 regression test contract specified; non-destructive safety reasoning documented; the EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS design for bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash ensures audit writes NEVER block business writes.

issues.description: Q1: audit-chain-skip RAISE WARNING rate could be capped per tenant to avoid log-spam under heavy shared-DB-state contamination. Out of scope for this fix; surface as a follow-up MINOR if it appears during validation.

Q2: bpm_audit_resource_info's table-by-table branches still cast src->>'id'::uuid for some tables; if any of those branches fires against a TEXT-keyed parent row, the C22P02 happens BEFORE the audit row INSERT and therefore before the trigger runs. The design calls for downgrading the cast in the same corrective migration, but BACKEND-DEV must verify every branch of the dispatcher and not just the 'ELSE fallback' branch.

result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 2b hard gate). After PASS: route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 3) to implement the migration + new test per src/design/audit_chain_text_resource_id.md.
